invoiceEmailSettings.title: Invoice Email Settings
invoiceEmailSettings.subtitle: Manage multiple SMTP sender accounts used for invoice emails.
invoiceEmailSettings.defaultAccountHint: The default account is preselected when sending invoice emails; you can switch to another account in the send dialog.
invoiceEmailSettings.passwordHint: Leave the password blank to keep the saved password. If password decryption fails, re-enter the SMTP password and save.
invoiceEmailSettings.keepOneAccount: Keep at least one sender account
invoiceEmailSettings.noPermission: The current account does not have permission to manage system settings, so saving and test sending are disabled.
invoiceEmailSettings.loadFailed: Failed to load invoice email settings
invoiceEmailSettings.saveFailed: Failed to save invoice email settings
invoiceEmailSettings.deleteConfirm: Delete this sender account? Takes effect after saving.
invoiceEmailSettings.validationFailed: Some account details are incomplete; jumped to the first account with errors
invoiceEmailSettings.sectionSenderHint: The address and name recipients will see.
invoiceEmailSettings.useSslHint: On: implicit SSL (usually port 465). Off: STARTTLS (usually port 587).
invoiceEmailSettings.passwordKeepHint: Password saved; leave blank to keep it
invoiceEmailSettings.sectionTestHint: Sends a test email using the current form values, including unsaved changes.
